title: [track] flaky EDHOC tests: 2 python coap tests fail intermittently, pass in isolation
description: P3, noted by wave-5 agent: 2 pre-existing EDHOC tests in python/tests/coap fail in the full-suite run but pass in isolation (test-ordering/shared-state interference, possibly the fixture regeneration side effects from the C_I transport encoding change). Identify the tests, find the cross-test contamination (module-level state? shared fixture cache?), fix or mark with a documented fixture-scoping change. Do not just reorder tests to mask it.
